20261119-chemistry-g05.title: wanda cakuɗa ce mai daidaito
20261119-chemistry-g05.goal: Aiwatar da ka'idojin wanda cakuɗa ce mai daidaito don warware matsalar bincike.
20261119-chemistry-g05.material: Ana son bincika halayen ruwan gishiri a cikin beaker. Wane bayani ne daidai game da halayen solution, wanda cakuɗa ce mai daidaito?
20261119-chemistry-g05.s.s1.prompt: Ana son bincika halayen ruwan gishiri a cikin beaker. Wane bayani ne daidai game da halayen solution, wanda cakuɗa ce mai daidaito?
20261119-chemistry-g05.s.s1.explain: Solution na gaskiya (cakuɗa mai daidaito) ƙwayoyin solute suna warwatse daidai tsakanin ƙwayoyin solvent, don haka ba sa nutsewa ko da an bar su na dogon lokaci, kuma concentration iri ɗaya ne a kowane wuri.
20261119-chemistry-g05.s.s1.hint.0: Solution 'cakuɗa mai daidaito (homogeneous)' ce inda ƙwayoyin suke haɗe daidai matakin ƙwayar guda.
20261119-chemistry-g05.s.s1.hint.1: Ba ya nutsewa duk tsawon lokacin da aka bar shi.
20261119-chemistry-g05.s.s1.o.o0: Ko da ka ɗauki ɗanɗano daga sama, tsakiya ko ƙasan solution, matakin gishiri (concentration) iri ɗaya ne daidai
20261119-chemistry-g05.s.s1.o.o1: Bayan lokaci gishirin yana nauyi kuma yana nutsewa a ƙasa da kansa
20261119-chemistry-g05.s.s1.o.o2: Idan aka duba da gilashin ƙara girma, ana ganin ƙwayoyin gishiri suna yawo a cikin ruwa
20261119-chemistry-g05.s.s1.o.o3: Idan aka tace da takardar tacewa, dukkan gishirin yana tacewa a saman takardar

20261121-chemistry-g05-2.title: tumatirin ya tashi yana yawo a saman ruwa
20261121-chemistry-g05-2.topic: tumatirin ya tashi yana yawo a saman ruwa
20261121-chemistry-g05-2.goal: Aiwatar da ka'idojin tumatirin ya tashi yana yawo a saman ruwa don warware matsalar bincike.
20261121-chemistry-g05-2.material: An saka tumatir ƙarami a tankin ruwa mai tsabta kuma ya nutse a ƙasa. Bayan an zuba gishiri mai yawa a tankin aka juya, tumatirin ya tashi yana yawo a saman ruwa. Menene dalili?
20261121-chemistry-g05-2.thinking.0: tumatirin ya tashi yana yawo a saman ruwa

20261122-chemistry-g05-1.title: Crystallization mai zurfi
20261122-chemistry-g05-1.goal: Aiwatar da ka'idojin Crystallization mai zurfi don warware matsalar bincike.
20261122-chemistry-g05-1.material: [Crystallization mai zurfi] An yi saturated solution ta hanyar narkar da alum a ruwa mai ɗumi 60℃ har sai ya daina narkewa, sannan aka ɗaura zaren siliki a cikin maganar aka bar ta ta yi sanyi a hankali a zafin ɗaki, sai kyawawan lu'ulu'un alum masu haske kamar duwatsu masu daraja suka girma a zaren. Menene ƙa'idar wannan al'amari?
20261122-chemistry-g05-1.s.s1.prompt: [Crystallization mai zurfi] An yi saturated solution ta hanyar narkar da alum a ruwa mai ɗumi 60℃ har sai ya daina narkewa, sannan aka ɗaura zaren siliki a cikin maganar aka bar ta ta yi sanyi a hankali a zafin ɗaki, sai kyawawan lu'ulu'un alum masu haske kamar duwatsu masu daraja suka girma a zaren. Menene ƙa'idar wannan al'amari?
20261122-chemistry-g05-1.s.s1.explain: Idan zafi ya ragu, solubility na solid yana raguwa sosai; don haka solute da ya fi solubility ɗin da ya yi ƙasa (supersaturated) yana haɗuwa ya samar da lu'ulu'u na tsari yana fita, wanda shi ne al'amarin 'recrystallization (precipitation)'.

20261122-chemistry-g05-2.goal: Aiwatar da ka'idojin Menene ƙa'idar kimiyya da take sa kumfa ya don warware matsalar bincike.
20261122-chemistry-g05-2.material: Menene ƙa'idar kimiyya da take sa kumfa ya tashi sosai daga cikin abin sha tare da sautin 'tss' lokacin da aka buɗe murfin gwangwanin abin sha mai sanyi mai kumfa (sprite, cola)?

20261119-chemistry-g06.title: kumfa yana fitowa
20261119-chemistry-g06.goal: Aiwatar da ka'idojin kumfa yana fitowa don warware matsalar bincike.
20261119-chemistry-g06.material: Idan aka digo dilute hydrochloric acid ko vinegar a kan ƙwan kwai ko guntun marmara (mai sinadarin calcium carbonate), kumfa yana fitowa. Menene zai faru idan aka tara gas ɗin aka ratsa shi ta cikin lime water?
20261119-chemistry-g06.s.s1.prompt: Idan aka digo dilute hydrochloric acid ko vinegar a kan ƙwan kwai ko guntun marmara (mai sinadarin calcium carbonate), kumfa yana fitowa. Menene zai faru idan aka tara gas ɗin aka ratsa shi ta cikin lime water?
20261119-chemistry-g06.s.s1.explain: Idan calcium carbonate ($\text{CaCO}_3$) ya yi reaction da acid, ana samar da gas ɗin carbon dioxide ($\text{CO}_2$), kuma carbon dioxide yana yin reaction da lime water ($\text{Ca(OH)}_2$) ya samar da precipitate fari na calcium carbonate, wanda ke sa shi ya yi gizagizai.
20261119-chemistry-g06.s.s1.hint.0: Idan carbonate ya yi reaction da acid, ana samar da gas ɗin carbon dioxide (CO₂).
20261119-chemistry-g06.s.s1.hint.1: Idan aka ratsa carbon dioxide ta lime water, ana samar da precipitate na calcium carbonate da ke sa shi ya yi gizagizai.
20261119-chemistry-g06.s.s1.o.o0: Lime water zai yi gizagizai fari (tabbatar da gas ɗin carbon dioxide)
20261119-chemistry-g06.s.s1.o.o1: Idan aka kawo wuta ga lime water, zai ƙone da sautin 'pop'
20261119-chemistry-g06.s.s1.o.o2: Launin lime water zai zama shuɗi
20261119-chemistry-g06.s.s1.o.o3: Babu wani canji da zai faru

20261122-chemistry-g06-1.title: Zaton reaction mai zurfi
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.goal: Aiwatar da ka'idojin Zaton reaction mai zurfi don warware matsalar bincike.
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.material: [Zaton reaction mai zurfi] An haɗa dilute hydrochloric acid da sodium hydroxide solution (wanda yake mayar da jan litmus paper zuwa shuɗi) ta hanyar digo shi a hankali da dropper. Idan aka saka isasshen hydrochloric acid, wane ne daidai game da canjin da ke faruwa a cikin cakuɗar solution?
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.s.s1.prompt: [Zaton reaction mai zurfi] An haɗa dilute hydrochloric acid da sodium hydroxide solution (wanda yake mayar da jan litmus paper zuwa shuɗi) ta hanyar digo shi a hankali da dropper. Idan aka saka isasshen hydrochloric acid, wane ne daidai game da canjin da ke faruwa a cikin cakuɗar solution?
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.s.s1.explain: Idan acid (hydrochloric acid) da base (sodium hydroxide) suka yi reaction, ana samar da ruwa da gishiri kuma ana fitar da zafin neutralization wanda ke sa zafi ya tashi. Idan aka ƙara hydrochloric acid fiye da kima, dukkan solution yana zama acidic ya mayar da shuɗin litmus paper zuwa ja.
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.s.s1.hint.0: A neutralization reaction ana samar da zafin neutralization kuma zafi yana ƙaruwa.
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.s.s1.hint.1: Idan hydrochloric acid ya yi yawa, solution yana zama acidic.
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.s.s1.o.o0: Ana samar da zafi, zafin ya tashi, kuma solution na ƙarshe yana mayar da shuɗin litmus paper zuwa ja
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.s.s1.o.o1: Solution yana yin sanyi sosai ya zama kankara
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.s.s1.o.o2: Babu wani reaction da ke faruwa kuma yana ci gaba da zama yadda yake
20261122-chemistry-g06-1.s.s1.o.o3: Gas ɗin hydrogen kawai ne yake fitowa da fashewa
